description: This bar chart illustrates the NPMI (Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information) scores for three different values of the parameter L—specifically L=1 (orange), L=2 (teal), and L=3 (purple)—across three distinct datasets: 20NG, IMDB, and NIPS. The horizontal axis categorizes the datasets, presented in the order 20NG, IMDB, and NIPS from left to right. The vertical axis represents the NPMI score, scaled linearly from 0.18 to 0.42, with tick marks and labels appearing at regular intervals. For each dataset, three bars are grouped side-by-side, corresponding to the three L values. In the 20NG dataset, the bars have approximate values of 0.375 (L=1), 0.379 (L=2), and 0.372 (L=3). In the IMDB dataset, the values are 0.199 (L=1), 0.202 (L=2), and 0.194 (L=3). In the NIPS dataset, the values are 0.409 (L=1), 0.410 (L=2), and 0.405 (L=3). The bars are not sorted by height; instead, they are presented in the order of the datasets. Each bar is labeled with its exact NPMI value, and the chart includes a legend in the top-left corner indicating the color coding for each L value. There are no visual emphasis techniques such as shading or bolding applied to any bars.
